scsp.note: PCM buffers live in the jo allocator zones (work RAM and cartridge), not SCSP RAM, and are fed to the SCSP by the driver; the constraint is allocator headroom. The total staged member set exceeds any single phase by design: residency is phase-bounded (boss-clear loads at the interior wipe after ~900 KB of opening PCM is released). A live allocator/SCSP high-water instrument is a GAP.
